name: Sophia
source: Cheerful, friendly, cute, and a little bit clumsy, Sophia is the legitimate princess of this region. After her whole family went missing during the war, she has been trying to find the true savior mentioned in the prophecy. Now her mission is to help Yuuta, the chosen one, to restore peace within these lands while putting her latest creation to the test… The Love Potion.
